issue.title: Mission progress not triggered when mission is uploaded from QGC
issue.body:
Hi
I try to run the QGC on the laptop 
PX4 by gazebo

When I try to use Mission::subscribe_mission_progress, my callback does not get invoked.

I tried to use the fly_mission.cpp example, even in that, the callback does not get invoked.

Any reason, or any pre-requsites?

comments.body:
Which version of MAVSDK are you using?

> Any reason, or any pre-requsites?

Well the example should work. For the QGC use-case, I would say that maybe MAVSDK needs to download the mission before it can report progress.

I am using v1.0.0 for compatibility with PX4 1.12.3 and QGC 4.2.2

I tried to download and track the progress in the example, then it works.

I used mavsdk in a ros node to download mission and track progress. In that, I can download but not subscribe to anything.

should  I have to include mavlink headers related to those subscriptions? Or just mavsdk should be enough to handle that?

> Or just mavsdk should be enough to handle that?

Not sure I understand that. MAVSDK needs to know about the mission, either by uploading it to the drone, or by downloading it from the drone (e.g. when QGC was the one uploading). Once MAVSDK knows about the mission, the progress subscription will work.

So from your ROS node you need to do what the example does: download (or upload) _and_ subscribe to the mission progress.

Does that answer your question?

I do the same. Download from drone and subscribe to track progress.

since subscribing listen to certain mavlink messages. I was confused if I have to include those mavlink headers.

Right now, I include mavsdk in package.xml and cmake.
Does it mean that it's working? Can we close this issue?

No, am sorry. Still we are not able to track the progress. But I can see that the mission gets downloaded correctly.
Am not sure what am missing

Can you then explain again what your problem is?

> I tried to download and track the progress in the example, then it works.

Seems to me that it is working when using MAVSDK, but you have issues with your ROS code. Is that correct?

Sorry for the late response.
I was not able to link up mission raw plugin with my ros node, the initial messages get listened. Then once the node gets started up, it does not listen anymore.
I am not sure of the reason.

i then managed to create another plugin to listen only for missed_reached message. I was able to listen and track the mission even without downloading the mission.

Now i try to subscribe to the updates. i get into a segmentation fault when trying to invoke callback  method at system_impl.cpp.


Does it have to do anything with passing back method as reference variable. Or anything i have to do differently when subscribing  from ros2 node? I tried passing lambda, method, same result.

It sounds like you are having issues with your own code and integrating with ROS. Or do you think there is a problem with MAVSDK?

If you have a bug with MAVSDK, can you please share a small reproducible example showing the bug?
For any generic QGC mission you should download it using the `MissionRaw` plugin. Then you should receive the progress.

Hi,
There was a small difference in creating plugin instance with respect to the standalone script.
I had to create a pointer for the plugin instance. And initialise it as
mission_raw = new mavsdk::MissionRaw{system}
Then it was able to track the callback.


And I checked tracking the progress, without downloading the mission -- it still works.

But that plugin is actually set to listen to 'Current' and 'Item reached' mavlink messages. But subscription is set to the details of 'Current' to be reported. So I had to create a separate subscription reporting for 'Item reached'.

But the purpose of opening is thread is clear and resolved now.
Thank you for the support.
